description: This file implements a dynamic vector of strings ('strvec') in C, including functions for initialization, insertion, removal, replacement, splitting, and detaching string arrays.

methods.name: void strvec_init(struct strvec * array)
methods.description: Initializes a strvec structure to an empty state.

methods.name: void strvec_push_nodup(struct strvec * array,char * value)
methods.description: Adds a string to the vector without duplicating it.

methods.name: const char * strvec_push(struct strvec * array,const char * value)
methods.description: Inserts a copy of a string into the vector.

methods.name: const char * strvec_pushf(struct strvec * array,const char * fmt,...)
methods.description: Formats and pushes a string into the vector.

methods.name: void strvec_pushl(struct strvec * array,...)
methods.description: Pushes multiple strings into the vector.

methods.name: void strvec_pushv(struct strvec * array,const char ** items)
methods.description: Pushes an array of strings into the vector.

methods.name: void strvec_splice(struct strvec * array,size_t idx,size_t len,const char ** replacement,size_t replacement_len)
methods.description: Replaces a segment of the vector with provided strings.

methods.name: const char * strvec_replace(struct strvec * array,size_t idx,const char * replacement)
methods.description: Replaces a string at a specific index.

methods.name: void strvec_remove(struct strvec * array,size_t idx)
methods.description: Removes the string at a given index.

methods.name: void strvec_pop(struct strvec * array)
methods.description: Removes the last string from the vector.

methods.name: void strvec_split(struct strvec * array,const char * to_split)
methods.description: Splits a string by whitespace into the vector.

methods.name: void strvec_clear(struct strvec * array)
methods.description: Clears all elements from the vector.

methods.name: const char ** strvec_detach(struct strvec * array)
methods.description: Detaches the internal array from the vector.

ctags.name: strvec_replace
ctags.pattern: /^const char *strvec_replace(struct strvec *array, size_t idx, const char *replacement)$/

ctags.name: strvec_splice
ctags.pattern: /^void strvec_splice(struct strvec *array, size_t idx, size_t len,$/
ctags.signature: (struct strvec * array,size_t idx,size_t len,const char ** replacement,size_t replacement_len)
